description: How many units of one or more products can be booked for an exact period at a location. Returns `available` and `plannable` (plannable can exceed available when shortage is allowed). Get location ids from booqable_list_locations. Booqable: GET /api/4/inventory_availabilities.

from.description: Period start, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

till.description: Period end, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

name: booqable_check_inventory_availability
title: Check inventory availability
